dedupe_keys.name: indian coal mine location and production dataset december 2020 from rti replies

description: A table of coal mines in India with their production and geographic coordinates, built by filing Right to Information (RTI) Act applications with Coal India Limited and its subsidiaries, Singareni Collieries Company Limited, NLC Ltd, the Ministry of Coal and the Coal Controller Organisation. The Dataverse record says the RTI replies, mostly PDFs, were typed into a spreadsheet by the researchers, and coordinates were taken from government documents or Google Maps; most are exact but some are approximate within the same locality. Version 1.0 was submitted on 8 January 2021 and released on 14 January 2021 by Sandeep Pai, Hisham Zerriffi and S. Kaluarachchi, as one downloadable tab-separated file (Indian Coal Mines Dataset, January 2021) of about 4 KB, free under CC0 1.0. Coverage is India's state and private coal companies as of December 2020. Caveats: it is a one-off snapshot tied to a just-transition paper, the RTI PDFs are not shared, and completeness depends on which companies replied. For simulation it gives mine locations and output for coal supply-chain and regional employment models of India, for example to test disruption of coal deliveries to power plants or the local effects of mine closures. A related catalogue record is the Global Energy Monitor Global Coal Mine Tracker.
